data_origin: generated by verify_model.py; no observed biological or paleo data
surrogate_spectrum: two Gaussian resonance basis functions multiplied by a bounded geometry factor; not a Maxwell solver
underwater_attenuation: synthetic wavelength-dependent exponential attenuation with arbitrary coefficients
phylogenetic_control: synthetic clade fixed intercept; not a molecular phylogeny or Brownian model
validation: within-clade held-out taxa, OLS, R-squared; 90 synthetic replicates per scenario

scenarios.optical_signal: response depends on surrogate optical score plus random clade effect and noise
scenarios.phylogeny_confounded: response depends on clade effect plus noise, not optical score directly

limits: does not estimate real species preference
does not validate phylogenetic comparative method
does not show a paleo-light proxy exists
does not reconstruct any lake or ocean core
